text: Blockchain-based Identity and Policy Management for Distributed Cloud Services presents the following source proposition: Centralized IAM and policy managers introduce single points of failure, limited auditability, and latency. This proposition is pertinent to Kaal's source-bound claim that No single, fixed, entirely algorithmic policing solution can completely prevent independent nodes in a distributed system from gaming block production to advantage some parties over others. Any consensus protocol that relies on a permanently fixed rule set will therefore be gamed as conditions change.
